raw_answer_text:
A1: It moves to SYN-RECEIVED and sends a SYN,ACK segment.
A2: It enters SYN-SENT and sends a SYN segment (also creating the TCB).
A3: It sends an ACK and the connection reaches ESTABLISHED.
A4: It moves to FIN-WAIT-1 and sends a FIN.
A5: It moves to CLOSE-WAIT and sends an ACK.
A6: A CLOSE from the local application moves it to LAST-ACK, and the TCP sends a FIN.
A7: It moves to CLOSING (it sends an ACK in response).
A8: 2MSL (two Maximum Segment Lifetimes).
